description: CP PLUS CP-UM64C micro-SD card is designed for consumer use Which offers high-speed data transfer, with a Class 10 rating and UHS (U3) speed grade, it is well-suited for tasks like recording high-resolution 4K/2K videos. The card has a minimum write speed of 30MB/s, ensuring smooth and reliable performance. It comes in three options: 64GB, 128 GB and 256 GB, offering ample storage space for your files, photos, and videos. The read speed of up to 70MB/s enables fast access to your data. It operates reliably in temperatures ranging from 0°C to 70°C, making it suitable for various environments. With a storage temperature range of -25°C to 85°C, it can withstand harsh conditions without compromising data integrity. Additionally, it is designed to handle humidity levels of up to 95% RH under 25°C, providing peace of mind in different climates. Overall, this micro-SD card offers excellent performance, reliability, and compatibility for consumer applications.
